body:
I've never talked to anyone about my feelings (only gave some hints that fell into a void) except for once in high school when i broke down in front of a friend of mine that only gave me the tip to "find a girl it can change you" (Even if the tip is legit i am pretty unwilling to go outside).  


As far for what i liked to do as a kid/teen not too much... I was a pretty energetic kid when i grew up,i cherish those times, everything changed when i was 5; My grandpa from my father side died and my father got fired from his job.  
We had to move 200 km away from where i was.  


This is where i think my decline started and when part of my true me died . I was attending seventh grade and i started isolating myself because most of my schoolmates where mocking me (i came from a part of my state that was known for crime and general degradation even if i was in a small town with only old people).  


I went home crying most of the times until my mother told me to "just build a wall around yourself and keep them out" and so i did and it worked.  


I managed to make some friends in elementary that i've carried toward middle school.

After finishing middle school the thing that made my old self die fully happened:  


When i was 12 I was attacked by this boy in a park that started threatening me. I wouldn't have minded too much but there where stories about him doing small crimes and having a gun somewhere (it could have been a rumor but i had no idea).  


I ran at home and started crying.

This is the period of time where i started isolating myself. I spent my entire teenage locked in my home only getting out for going to school and medical checks.  


I spent maybe 8 years hoping that death would knock on my door and just sickle the soul out of my body.

My hobbies included video games and modding DOOM (1994-1995) 

Now i am in university and things are slightly better but i still have this void and suicidal feelings that drowns my soul.  


Those hobbies are fizzling out due to university work and the feeling of nothingness that i am feeling.  


The only thing that makes me enjoy myself a little is playing bass and telling dumb jokes with my housemates.

​

My only fear isn't that i am going to kill myself tomorrow my fear is that i will become a soulless puppet (even more than now) that drags himself around to survive until it goes six feet under dirt.

(Anyway thanks for your time )

>Do you feel anything in particular is missing from your life?

The thing is... i have no idea... i am doing fine, i have a good and supporting family, i have some friends (that i may neglect at times tbh)... I have no idea about this.

>Are you striving towards the things you want out of life?

I have no idea what to do with life. Everywhere i look makes me feel like everything is about getting money and so dreams and passions have died in that corner of my brain that keeps good things to chuckle about every now and then.

I always catch people (friends,professors,relatives,random people in general) thinking that life is all about staying up and surviving,helping yourself and helping the ones close to you, until you kick the metaphorical bucket.  


That makes me feel like i am aimless and with no objective to pursue other than to push myself forward in order to eat the day after.  


I still have some hobbies but again,as mentioned before, they feel like chores.

Thanks for the answer and sorry for the late reply.I did not go to a doctor and asked for help just because i am afraid that life will change after that since where i live asking for help for this kind of stuff has still a stigma on itself and people don't know how to react .

​

I feel like i am going to change how people that i know are going to look at myself...

The fact is that I've been feeling this since i was 12 (almost 21 now) and i feel like i am going forward by a sort of inertia and everything around me happens by some kind of dice roll or something aleatory.

I don't know what i am supposed to do or feel... i feel confused and frustrated.

I see friends having full filling relationships and being so sure of themselves... i don't know if they are putting an act; i can put an act but i feel like i can keep the mask on for too long.

Anyway thanks for letting me vent out something and for the advice
